picker_blurb: Tank — high HP/DEF. Skill varies by subclass.
flavor: Every casino needs muscle. The Enforcer doesn't out-think you — they outlast you, plant themselves between the house and the door, and dare you to try something. Chips fly, tables get flipped, and they're still standing when the dust settles.

picker_blurb: Support — balanced spread. Skill varies by subclass.
flavor: The Pit Boss runs the floor. One word and the whole table falls in line — dealers straighten up, security clears a path, marks freeze mid-bet. They don't need to swing to win a fight.

picker_blurb: High ATK, fragile. Skill varies by subclass.
flavor: The Oracle still sits at the table and still bets like everyone else — they just already know which card is coming. By the time they call, the outcome was never in doubt.
The Hustler never plays it straight. Marked decks, quick hands, an exit already scoped before the first bet's down — they win by making sure the odds were never fair to begin with.
